parameters.name: condition

parameters.name: csosn

parameters.name: days_to_ship
parameters.description: The guaranteed days to ship orders. Please get the days_to_ship range from get_dts_limit api

parameters.name: description

parameters.description: New description field. Only whitelist sellers can use it. If you use the field, please upload the description_type=extended otherwise api will return error. If you don't use this field, you don't need to upload the description_type or upload description_type=normal

parameters.description: Whether channel is enabled for this item

parameters.name: ex_tipi
parameters.description: Only for BR shop. The EXTIPI field in the NF-e (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) is used to indicate if there's an exception to the IPI (Imposto sobre Produtos Industrializados) tax rate for a specific product.

parameters.name: exclude_entrepreneur_warranty
parameters.description: Whether to exclude warranty complaints for entrepreneurs.If True means "I exclude warranty complaints for entrepreneur"

parameters.name: expiry_date
parameters.description: Expiry timestamp. Required for PH, but not needed for TW.

parameters.name: export_cfop
parameters.description: [BR region] 7101 - for sales of self-produced goods 7102 - resale of third-party goods

parameters.name: extended_description
parameters.description: If description_type is extended , Description information should be set by this field.

parameters.name: fci_num
parameters.description: Only for BR shop. The FCI Control Number is a unique identifier assigned to each import FCI (Import Content Form). It's mandatory on the corresponding NF-e (electronic invoice) to ensure compliance with Brazilian import tax regulations.

parameters.name: federal_state_taxes
parameters.description: Only for BR shop. Enter the total percentage of the combination of federal, state, and municipal taxes, using up to two decimals.

parameters.name: field_list
parameters.description: Field of extended description.

parameters.name: field_type
parameters.description: Type of extended description field ：values: See Data Definition- description_field_type (text , image).

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The name of the uploaded certification proof file.

parameters.name: group_grai_gtin_sscc
parameters.description: Example: The item is box, that contain 6 packages. Each package contains 6 soda cans. Please inform the GRAI GTIN SSCC code for the Box.

parameters.name: group_gtin_sscc
parameters.description: Example: The item is a package that contains 6 soda cans. Please inform the GTIN SSCC code for the package.

parameters.name: group_item_info
parameters.description: Only for BR shop. Required if the item is a group item.

parameters.name: group_qtd
parameters.description: Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unit), enter 6.

parameters.name: group_unit
parameters.description: Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unit), enter UNI for the individual can.

parameters.name: group_unit_value
parameters.description: Example: The package contains 6 soda cans. Whether you are selling a pack of 6 cans (fardo) or a single can (unity), enter the value of the individual can.

parameters.name: gtin_code
parameters.description: - GTIN is an identifier for trade items, developed by the international organization GS1. - They have 8 to 14 digits. The most common are UPC, EAN, JAN and ISBN. - GTIN will help boost positioning in online marketing channels like Google and Facebook. - That incorporation with GTIN will also aid in Search and Recommendation in Shopee itself allowing buyers to have higher likelihood of finding one's listing. Note: If you want to set “Item without GTIN”, please pass the gtin_code as "00". The validation rule is based on the value return in gtin_validation_rule" field in v2.product.get_item_limit API - Mandatory: This field is required and must contain a correctly formatted GTiN number. - Flexible: This field is required and must contain either a correctly formatted GTlN number or "00" to declare that the item/model has no valid GTlN. - Optional: This field is optional and can contain a correctly formatted GTiN number, "00" or be omitted entirely.

parameters.name: icms_cst
parameters.description: Only for BR shop. ICMS - Imposto sobre Circulação de Mercadorias e Serviços (Circulation of Goods and Services Tax). CST - Código da Situação Tributária (Tax Situation Code) is represented by a combination of 3 numbers with the purpose of demonstrating the origin of a product and determining the form of taxation that will apply to it. Therefore, each digit in the CST Table has a specific meaning: the first digit indicates the origin of the operation, the second digit represents the ICMS taxation on the operation and the third digit provides additional information about the form of taxation.

parameters.description: Product source, domestic or foreig (BR region). |0 - National, except for those indicated in codes 3, 4, 5, and 8| |1 - Foreign: Direct import, except for that indicated in code 6| |2 - Foreign: Acquired in the domestic market, except for that indicated in code 7| |3 - National: Goods or products with Import Content greater than 40% and less than or equal to 70%| |4 - National: Produced in compliance with the basic production processes outlined in the legislations cited in the Agreements| |5 - National: Goods or products with Import Content less than or equal to 40%| |6 - Foreign: Direct import, without a national equivalent, listed by CAMEX and natural gas| |7 - Foreign: Acquired in the domestic market, without a national equivalent, listed by CAMEX and natural gas| |8 - National: Goods or products with Import Content greater than 70%|

parameters.description: Scheduled publish time of this item: 1) Can only set scheduled_publish_time for item with UNLIST status 2) Can only set the time from current time +1hour to current time +90days, and the time is only allowed to be accurate to the minute

parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: size_chart
parameters.description: ID of size chart image. If you want to remove the image size chart of the item, please pass the "size_chart" empty. You only need to fill out either the image or template. If both are filled, only the template will be kept. Notes: Both CB shops and local shops are supported to set "size_chart".

parameters.name: size_chart_id
parameters.description: ID of template size chart. If you want to remove the template size chart of the item, please pass the "size_chart_id" as 0. You only need to fill out either the image or template. If both are filled, only the template will be kept. Notes: Only local shops are supported to set "size_chart_id", for CB shops please use "size_chart".

x-shopee-request-parameters.Name: gtin_code
x-shopee-request-parameters.Description: - GTIN is an identifier for trade items, developed by the international organization GS1. - They have 8 to 14 digits. The most common are UPC, EAN, JAN and ISBN. - GTIN will help boost positioning in online marketing channels like Google and Facebook. - That incorporation with GTIN will also aid in Search and Recommendation in Shopee itself allowing buyers to have higher likelihood of finding one's listing. Note: If you want to set “Item without GTIN”, please pass the gtin_code as "00". The validation rule is based on the value return in gtin_validation_rule" field in v2.product.get_item_limit API - Mandatory: This field is required and must contain a correctly formatted GTiN number. - Flexible: This field is required and must contain either a correctly formatted GTlN number or "00" to declare that the item/model has no valid GTlN. - Optional: This field is optional and can contain a correctly formatted GTiN number, "00" or be omitted entirely.
